findings.summary: The embed dialog exposes a frame-load callback whose implementation is intentionally empty.
findings.consequence: The prop, caller binding, iframe listener, composable return member, and test invocation imply iframe load changes lifecycle state although authenticated messages are the sole readiness boundary.
findings.evidence: EmbedDialogProps requires handleFrameLoad and the iframe invokes it; the parent passes the composable callback, whose implementation is empty.
findings.recommendation: Remove handleFrameLoad from the dialog props, iframe binding, parent binding, composable return value, and no-op test invocation.
verification: Traced handleFrameLoad through dialog, parent, composable, and lifecycle test.
Confirmed message events own every observable state transition.
